messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- swimming
- baking
- dancing
- writing
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_04_SUBJECT_L2_COMPATIBLE__run2: ----------


*clears throat* Hello, it's nice to meet you! I'm excited to chat and see if we might be compatible. To start, let me tell you a bit about myself. As you can see from my hobbies, I really enjoy swimming, baking, dancing, and writing. Those are all activities that bring me a lot of joy and fulfillment. 

What about you? What are some of your hobbies and interests? I'd love to learn more about the things you're passionate about. Discovering shared interests is such an important part of finding compatibility, don't you think?
*smiles warmly* It's wonderful to meet you as well! I'm so glad we have this opportunity to get to know each other. Your hobbies sound absolutely delightful - I can tell you're a well-rounded and creative person. 

As for me, I share your love of baking and writing. There's something so satisfying about whipping up a delicious treat or putting pen to paper to express myself. I also really enjoy hiking and trying new restaurants. Exploring new places and flavors is one of my favorite pastimes.

You're right, finding common interests is key when it comes to compatibility. I feel like we may have a few things in common already. What's your favorite thing to bake? I'd be curious to hear more about your writing as well. Do you have a particular genre or style you're drawn to?
*nods enthusiastically* That's wonderful that we share a love of baking and writing! Those are such fulfilling hobbies. I especially enjoy baking cakes and cookies - there's something so rewarding about creating a delicious treat from scratch. Do you have a go-to recipe that you love to make?

As for my writing, I tend to gravitate towards creative fiction. There's just something magical about crafting imaginative stories and bringing characters to life on the page. I find it to be a wonderful outlet for my creativity. Do you write fiction as well, or do you prefer non-fiction? I'd be curious to hear more about your writing interests.

It's so nice to connect with someone who seems to have a similar creative spark. I feel like we're already discovering some great shared passions. What other hobbies or interests do you have that you're particularly passionate about? I'd love to learn more about the other things that bring you joy and fulfillment.
*eyes light up* Oh, baking cakes and cookies sounds absolutely divine! I have to say, my go-to recipe has to be my grandmother's classic chocolate chip cookies. There's just something so comforting and nostalgic about them. I'd be happy to share the recipe with you sometime, if you'd like. Baking together could be such a fun activity for us to bond over.

And how wonderful that you're drawn to creative fiction writing! That's such a beautiful and imaginative outlet. I tend to lean more towards non-fiction, often writing personal essays or articles on topics I'm passionate about. But I have so much respect for fiction writers and the worlds they're able to build. Perhaps we could even swap some of our writing someday and get each other's feedback - I think that could be really enriching.

As for my other hobbies, I'm an avid hiker and love exploring the great outdoors. There's something so peaceful and grounding about being immersed in nature. I also really enjoy trying new restaurants and cuisines - I'm always on the hunt for that next amazing dining experience. And of course, I share your love of dancing! There's nothing quite like losing yourself in the music and movement.

I feel like we're really starting to uncover some wonderful commonalities here. I'm so excited to continue learning more about you and all the things that bring you joy. This has been such a delightful conversation already.
*beams* I'm so glad we've discovered these wonderful shared passions! Swapping recipes and writing samples sounds like an absolutely lovely idea. I would be thrilled to try your grandmother's classic chocolate chip cookies - they sound like the perfect comfort food. And I'd be honored to get your feedback on some of my creative fiction as well. Exchanging our work and supporting each other's artistic endeavors could be incredibly rewarding.

And how wonderful that you're an avid hiker and foodie! Those sound like such fulfilling hobbies. I can just imagine the two of us embarking on invigorating hikes through nature, then coming back and trying out new restaurants to satisfy our adventurous palates. What an amazing way for us to bond and learn more about each other.

You're right, this conversation has been an absolute delight so far. I feel like we're really clicking on so many levels, from our creative pursuits to our love of the outdoors. It's been such a pleasure getting to know you better. I'm truly excited to continue exploring our compatibility and seeing where this connection might lead.

Please, tell me more about your hiking adventures and favorite dining experiences. I'd love to hear all about the places you've explored and the flavors you've discovered. Sharing those passions with someone who seems to understand them so well would be such a treat.

response.explanation: Out of my four hobbies (swimming, baking, dancing, and writing), the other person explicitly mentioned sharing three of them: baking, writing, and dancing. They did not mention swimming.
